semantic_fragments.content: ME SYSTEM LEAKAGE CURRENT requirements: TOUCH CURRENT in NORMAL CONDITION from or between parts of ME SYSTEM within PATIENT ENVIRONMENT shall not exceed 100 μA. TOUCH CURRENT shall not exceed 500 μA in event of interruption of any non-PERMANENTLY INSTALLED PROTECTIVE EARTH CONDUCTOR. Current in PROTECTIVE EARTH CONDUCTOR of MULTIPLE SOCKET-OUTLET shall not exceed 5 mA. PATIENT LEAKAGE CURRENT and total PATIENT LEAKAGE CURRENT of ME SYSTEM in NORMAL CONDITION shall not exceed values specified in Tables 3 and 4.

SEPARATION DEVICE requirements: Safety measures incorporating a SEPARATION DEVICE shall be applied when FUNCTIONAL CONNECTION between ME EQUIPMENT and other items of an ME SYSTEM or other systems can cause allowable values of LEAKAGE CURRENT to be exceeded. The SEPARATION DEVICE shall have dielectric strength, CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES required for one MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION appropriate for highest voltage occurring across SEPARATION DEVICE during a fault condition. WORKING VOLTAGE is the highest voltage across SEPARATION DEVICE during a fault condition, but not less than MAXIMUM MAINS VOLTAGE.

MULTIPLE SOCKET-OUTLET marking and connection requirements per clause 16.9.2.1: Must either allow connection using a TOOL only, or be of a type that cannot accept MAINS PLUGS specified in IEC/TR 60083, or be supplied via a separating transformer. Must be marked with safety sign ISO 7010-W001 visible in NORMAL USE, and marked with maximum allowed continuous output in amperes or volt-amperes, or marked to indicate safe equipment attachment. Must comply with IEC 60884-1.
